Prayer ministry

Prayer is at the heart of who we are. We gather to pray for our nation, our leaders, our church, and the people of our community.

Join us in seeking God together.

Men of God

A place for men to grow in faith and build lasting friendships through fellowship breakfasts, outings, conferences, and retreats.

Fellowship, encouragement, and life in the Word.

Women’s ministry

Women growing together through Bible study, fellowship, outreach, and service. We encourage one another to live lives grounded in Scripture.

Connecting faith with everyday life.

Celebrate Recovery

A Christ-centered, Bible-based recovery ministry for people facing hurts, habits, and hang-ups. The program brings together eight recovery principles and twelve steps.

Find encouragement and take your next step.

Evangelism & outreach

Sharing the good news of Jesus through community outreach, tent revivals, Bible distribution, concerts, missionary support, and mission trips.

Loving our neighbors in Dove Springs and beyond.

Kids for Christ

Our Sunday School helps children learn about Jesus through the Bible, creative activities, take-home materials, and time together.
